jobs_label: 500 projected by the company (NewsChannel 9, 2026-10-02); TNECD release gives no count
summary: Retool Spring Hill plant for LMR battery cells; completion 2028.
detail: Announced 2026-09-29: retool the Spring Hill cell plant to mass-produce prismatic lithium manganese-rich (LMR) cells; modifications start late 2026, completion 2028. Per trade press the $1B also covers the existing energy-storage cell program and facility improvements through 2030.

summary: U.S. HQ relocation + new manufacturing hub near I-65/Saturn Pkwy.
detail: Announced 2026-07-31: U.S. headquarters relocates from Franklin and co-locates with a new U.S. manufacturing hub near I-65 and Saturn Parkway.

summary: Future Cadillac ICE vehicle + extend 2.7L turbo engine program.
detail: Reported 2026-06-30 (GM release via CBT News): more than $150M at Spring Hill Assembly for a future Cadillac ICE vehicle; $125M at Spring Hill Engine to extend the 2.7L turbo program.

summary: About 40,000 sq ft expansion for manufacturing.
detail: Expansion announced 2026-02-26 adding about 40,000 sq ft for manufacturing and maintenance.

summary: Adds about 100,000 sq ft at Mount Pleasant plant.
detail: Announced 2026-06-25: long-term lease adding about 100,000 sq ft to its existing Mount Pleasant plant, in operation there since 1994. Serves aerospace, defense, medical and industrial customers.

summary: First U.S. steel lattice transmission tower plant; commissioning end of 2027.
detail: First U.S. steel lattice transmission tower plant, announced 2026-04-28 at a Select Tennessee Certified Site; full commissioning targeted end of 2027.

summary: First Tennessee greenhouse campus; 20-acre phase 1 commissioning.
detail: First Tennessee greenhouse campus, announced 2025-06-30 at a Select Tennessee Certified Site. Company says commissioning of the 20-acre first phase began and first seeds were planted (PR Newswire, 2026-08-13).

summary: 24,000 sq ft expansion at Team Lawrence Commerce Park.
detail: Expansion announced 2025-05-16 adding 24,000 sq ft at its existing plant on a Select Tennessee Certified Site.
